name: retrain-simulation-trade
notes: ADR-0185: the decision graph RetrainedSimulation runs as the last stage of run-retrain-simulation.json. It is ADR-0184's graph (bars -> publisher -> per-tick EquityKellyMIO decider -> DevelopmentSimulation -> report -> writers) with four changes: it decides EVERY MINUTE (ADR-0186: the minute publisher emits per-minute tick columns from the walk's trade predictions, and the minute simulation sizes each minute, skipping held, queued and after-close units and carrying a lot open at a release boundary into the next release; scoring, calibration and gates stay on the 30-minute lattice); funding is cash-flow-policy-biweekly.json ($10,000 initial, $500 every other Friday 09:30 New York, holiday -> next trading day, booked before a same-instant decision); the owner-delegated growth-policy-v1 MIO values replace ADR-0184's historical placeholders; and every value marked BOUND-BY-STAGE is bound by the stage to THIS staged run: the publisher's inventory/gates artifacts and their sha256 (read at bind time), walk_root (the directory the walk ran from) and the writers' output directory (<run>/stages/simulate/). A template with any other value there is refused, so no stale pin can ride along. Developmental post-selection, deployment_eligible=false; the policy is a judgement call, not a tuned or deployment-validated optimum. Not runnable on its own: run the staged document.

bars_a.notes: Split-adjusted SIP minutes holding the admitted LLY and XLK (and the other P13 names this source carries, dropped by simulate). start_ms = the fold-2 cutoff 2022-09-09; end_ms (exclusive) = 2025-10-17, the day after evidence_end, so nothing after the evidence window is read. RTH only, the tape the P16 labels count lead bars on.

bars_e.notes: Split-adjusted SIP minutes holding the admitted ADBE, CIEN, LITE, LRCX, LULU, MSTR, NOW, PANW, TER. Same window as bars_a.

params.provenance_waiver: Each bar record already carries its source; the two sources' symbol namespaces are disjoint and checked below.

publish.notes: ADR-0186: releases are ADR-0184's (calibration, false signal and caps from the scored lattice rows) plus each lead group's scenario constants; ticks carry every minute of each release's pinned trade predictions, refused unless they equal the scored yhat at every lattice stamp.

decide.notes: ADR-0185 growth policy v1, owner delegated to best judgement on 2026-09-25: growth-oriented CRRA gamma 2.0; 32 tangents; 128 scenarios; 95% CVaR capped at $500 per lead-group solve; no cardinality cap and no minimum ticket (owner ruling 2026-09-25: neither is imposed as a hard rule; whole-share lots and the per-share cost terms remain); HFDR q 0.20 on pi_widened (a widened point estimate, not a bound); 10 bp band; $5,000 per-name ceiling; zero bundle staleness; 64-day cap/calibration age; 0.53 uncertainty coverage floor (equal to the publisher's attested false-signal attainment). cap_evidence_look_ahead remains true because gate admission uses all 20 folds, so this remains developmental post-selection and is not deployment evidence. These are explicit policy choices, not tuned optima.

simulate.notes: ADR-0186: one MIO solve per lead group per minute; a full run makes ~2M solves, so solve rows are counted in the metadata (keep_solves false), not kept.
